capabilities: Open cited PDFs in Zotero via Cmd-click on a Pandoc @citekey
Jump to the cited page using locators like [p. 8]
Resolve citation keys to PDF attachments over the local Better BibTeX JSON-RPC port
Refresh the list of searchable Zotero libraries from the command palette
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.4.0+, uses local Node http); communicates only with Zotero over 127.0.0.1 with no other network requests. The manifest carries an 'not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff' notice.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's citation-aware plugins (e.g. Pandoc Reference List) show a bibliography sidebar and tooltips, but their best "open" action drops
motivation: The README's Why section says the plugin was built to close the last step that existing citation-aware plugins leave open — manually finding the PDF and page in Zotero.
problem: Citation plugins like Pandoc Reference List only drop you in the Zotero collection view, leaving you to navigate to the PDF and page yourself.

relations.evidence: Zotero with the Better BibTeX extension installed and running
The Better BibTeX integration approach draws on patterns from mgmeyers/obsidian-pandoc-reference-list
Obsidian's citation-aware plugins (e.g. Pandoc Reference List) show a bibliography sidebar and tooltips

requires.name: Zotero with the Better BibTeX extension

summary: Citation-link plugin that opens cited PDFs in Zotero at the cited page when you Cmd-click a Pandoc @citekey in a note.
